test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding the condition of agriculture at the time of independence?

options.text: Zamindars helped in improving the condition of farmers.
The land tenure system was characterised by intermediaries.
Low productivity of the agricultural sector
Indian farmers were encouraged to produce cash crops

solution:
The correct answer is __**Zamindars helped in improving the condition of farmers.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points __ 

**Zamindari System**

__
 
• Zamindari system of agriculture was **mainly practiced in Bengal **during British rule, which was the capital of British India.
 
• During the independence, zamindars helped farmers to improve the condition of their farms.
 
• The main intention of zamindars was not to help the farmers but **wanted to reap the benefits of the agriculture sector.**
 
• According to this system, the major part of the profit went to zamindars instead of the farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Through the Permanent Settlement Act, **Cornwallis introduced the Zamindari System in 1793.**
 
• It first appeared in the Bengal, Bihar, Orissa, and Varanasi provinces.
 
• **It is also known as the Permanent Settlement System.**
 
• Land ownership was acknowledged to belong to zamindars.
 
• The authority to collect rent from the peasants was granted to the zamindars.
 
• The actual farmers were made tenants while the zamindars acquired ownership of the land.
